## Name & positioning
- Product name: SnapDemo
- One-line value: SnapDemo turns a product screenshot into a clickable demo storyboard — hotspot ideas, narration beats, and a shareable walkthrough outline for PMs and marketers who need a first-pass interactive demo without a full recording studio.
- Domain: https://screenshot-to-demo.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## Domain context (verified primary sources)

## FAQ
Q1. What is SnapDemo?
A1. SnapDemo drafts a clickable demo storyboard from a screenshot description.
Q2. Who should use it?
A2. PMs, marketers, and founders who need a first-pass interactive walkthrough.
Q3. Does it record video for me?
A3. No. It plans hotspots and narration; you build the demo in your tool.
Q4. What inputs do I need?
A4. What the screenshot shows, audience, and the action you want viewers to take.
Q5. Does it guarantee conversion?
A5. No. It is decision-support storyboarding, not a growth guarantee.
Q6. Can it invent UI that is not in the shot?
A6. No. Stay honest to the screenshot; flag missing screens separately.
